# Calderbank Records Management - vault workspace

Shared folder for the vault team.

- vault/  carton cards for the storage bays
- moves/  collection move requests

turns.prompt: A client of Calderbank asked what a records carton is worth on the vault sheet; the house charges shelving by the linear foot and allows 1.2 linear feet to one carton. The collection to be moved holds 84 cartons. Give the linear feet the collection will occupy. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
